properties.name: Rancho Acalanes (Elam Brown purchase)
properties.description: 3,329-acre Mexican land grant (granted 1834 to Candelario Valencia) bought by Elam Brown for $900 in 1847. It covers almost all of present-day Lafayette. Point is the city centroid, not a building.
properties.coord_source: area symbol at Nominatim city centroid
